items.name: Moonmoth

origin.subject: Visual overhaul: animal foes, sprite attacks with trails, siege frame and HUD

items.desc: A luna moth: broad wings whose fields are dusty dark teal with a pale mint edge band and two cream eye-spots on each wing, a plump cream furry body, feathery antennae, two long tail streamers. Pose: seen from directly above, both wings fully and symmetrically spread like a pinned specimen, the body vertical in the middle, the head and antennae at the top and the two tail streamers at the bottom.
